alt: 老人在家中安靜讀書、照顧盆栽，外出的鞋袋整齊放在門旁，窗外鄰居出門時，她仍自在地留在屋內。
scene_prompt: 深居簡出 means living quietly at home and rarely going out, not being imprisoned or afraid of people. Contemporary retired writer's cozy modest home shown from inside with a wide view toward the front entry window. An elderly woman in comfortable everyday clothes sits contentedly at a small desk by a bookshelf, reading and tending a small potted plant. A pair of outdoor shoes and a neatly hung shoulder bag by the closed front door remain undisturbed, while warm house slippers are on her feet. Outside the window several neighbors walk to a busy community gathering down the lane, but the woman prefers her peaceful indoor routine, no one trying to force her outside. Add a domestic cat asleep nearby and a tea cup on a stable side table. Emphasize a self-chosen private, habitual home life rather than one temporary afternoon or sadness; full indoor reading and art materials organized around her. Calm expression, no locks, barred windows, piles of deliveries, sickness or depression cues. Exactly two arms and legs, proper fingers holding book, chair and desk grounded. Pages contain only subtle unreadable graphite texture, no text.
